This Dashboard summarizes the Ask Nicely Survey Responses across 3 types (Onboarding, No Website, With Website).

Dealer Responses are ranked as: Detractor (0-5), Passive (6-8), or Promoter (9-10) based on the Overall Satisfaction question.

Onboarding Surveys are sent to the Primary POC 7 days after the Onboarding Status is changed to 'Launched'.. Retention Surveys are sent to Primary POC, GM, Dealer Principal, & Service Director on a quarterly basis AND must have a minimum of the first 3 months of budgets..
